Smart-Idler is for improvement teams focussing on unlocking unrealised latent capacity in bulk handling operations, who are not getting what they need from manual conveyor inspection methods or other autonomous monitoring methods.

Smart-Idler is a conveyor roller sub-component that embeds intelligence into ordinary conveyor rollers from your chosen brand and monitors for end-of-life, predicting failure in advance and communicating back-to-base over radio for maintenance reporting.

Description:
Aurotron International  is a privately owned Australian company. In partnership with the UNSW, Australia, Aurotron designs and manufactures integrated autonomous steering and control systems for off-the-shelf tractors, called Autonomous Agriculture Machines (AAMs).
AAMs, are driverless tractors and other types of machinery that perform specific or a multitude of operations on a farm. Aurotron in partnership with UNSW, Australia, is releasing its first AAM model for weed spot spraying in April 2015. Planter/seeder models will follow from mid 2015.
The machines are programmed to drive a specific path across the fields whilst autonomously conducting the intended job, eg. spraying and planting. The farmer remotely monitors the operation of the machine whilst the machine itself continuously assesses its status and health. If the machine encounters any issues it will alert the farmer and automatically stop operations.
AAMs provide many benefits such as reduced labour input, lower machinery and maintenance costs and in spraying applications a reduction in chemical input. This productivity gain through cost decreases leads to increased farm profitability. The example at the end of the article demonstrates the staggering cost savings that AAMs can achieve, in the case of a 5,000 hectare farm in excess of A$150,000 in capital investment costs and on-going annual cost savings in excess of A$400,000.
AAMs provide a first step from mechanisation to automation in agriculture – a paradigm shift that led to massive productivity gains in other industries, namely manufacturing in the 20th century.

Driven by the need to embrace Cybersecurity in Functional Safety, John Lear and Keerthy Mysore founded KAJE Cyber to Cybersecure your Plant.

At KAJE Cyber, we provide ISA/IEC 62443 Lifecycle Services in Industrial Cybersecurity to Cybersecure your Plant.

Our mantra: Assess, Implement & Maintain.

Assess
The Assess phase starts with a High Level Cybersecurity Risk Assessment which helps determine the type and extent of risks faced by the Organisation e.g., Health & Safety risk, Environmental risk, Financial risk, Reputation vis-a-vis the Risk Tolerance criteria.  This is followed by a Vulnerability Assessment and a Detailed Cybersecurity Risk Assessment where a Security Level SL (Target) is assigned to each zone / conduit.

Implement
Once a SL (Target) has been assigned to a zone /conduit in the Assess phase, countermeasures are implemented during the Implement phase to reach SL (Achieved) better than or equal to SL (Target).  The SL (Achieved) is determined after the system has been validated against the security requirements for the zone / conduit.

Maintain
Countermeasures and inherent security properties of devices and systems degrade over time.  The security properties relevant to the zones / conduits must be audited and / or tested at regular intervals or whenever a new vulnerability is discovered during the Maintain phase to ensure that SL (Achieved) is better than or equal to SL (Target) at any point in time.

Description:

Name: Burkert Danmark A/S
Description:
Bürkert er en globalt ledende og innovativ leverandør af produkter og løsninger til automationsopgaver. Det omfattende produktprogram til at måle, styre og regulere væsker og gasser finder anvendelse i en mangfoldighed af brancher, lige fra vandbehandling, fødevare-, farma- og bio-virksomheder, laboratorier og dentalvirksomheder samt rumfartsteknik. Med en produktportofolio på mere end 30.000 produkter er Bürkert en af de få leverandører på markedet, der kan klare hele loopet med måling, styring og regulering af processer. Produktprogrammet går lige fra magnetventiler og procesventiler til sensorer for niveau, flow, tryk, pH, ledningsevne og temperatur, og produkterne udmærker sig ved, at de kan sammensættes til komplette kontrolsystemer. Systemerne kan skræddersyes lige fra et ukompliceret on/off system til mere komplekse proceskontrolsystemer.

Bürkert koncernen har hovedsæde i Ingelfingen i Tyskland, 5 produktionsfabrikker, 5 systemhuse i Tyskland, Kina og USA, og datterselskaber i mere end 30 lande. Bürkert beskæftiger på globalt plan 3.700 medarbejdere, heraf 32 medarbejdere i det danske selskab i Skovlunde.

Name: Pilz Australia
Description:
Pilz Australia is a leading expert in machinery safety, functional safety, and compliance with Australian Standards, including AS 4024. Established in the late 1990s, Pilz Australia has built a strong reputation as a trusted partner for safe automation, delivering machinery safety solutions that protect people, equipment, and productivity. Our local expertise is backed by the global strength of the Pilz Group, a pioneer in safe automation since 1948.

With offices in Melbourne (head office) and Sydney, our team of specialist engineers provides end-to-end machinery safety services across Australia. This includes risk assessments, safety design, validation, consulting, and industry-recognised training programmes.

Our portfolio includes safety sensors, safety relays, configurable and programmable safety controllers, safe drive technology, industrial communication solutions, including FSoE and IO-Link Safety and safety software. Together, our technologies and services help manufacturers, OEMs, system integrators and asset owners improve safety performance and achieve compliance throughout the machine lifecycle across industries like manufacturing, F&B, mining, rail and more.

Drawing on this comprehensive portfolio, Pilz Australia supports compliance with Key Australian and international standards, including AS 4024 (Safety of Machinery), AS/NZS ISO 12100, AS/NZS ISO 13849, IEC 62061, IEC 61508, and IEC 62443 for Industrial Security. Our practical, risk-based approach helps organisations reduce risk, meet regulatory requirements, and implement machinery safety solutions tailored to their operational needs.

Supporting this commitment to quality and compliance, Pilz Australia is an ISO 9001-certified machinery safety provider. Operating under internationally recognised quality management systems, we maintain consistent service delivery, technical excellence, and continual improvement across our consulting, engineering, training, and safety technology solutions.

Name: Hyperion Systems
Description:

Our vision transcends traditional manufacturing; we are committed to building a global network of on-demand, advanced manufacturing facilities that not only print but also recycle products close to where they are needed, aligning our vision with governments targets for recycling usage in ongoing materials manufacture 

This approach reduces waste, shortens supply chains, and brings sustainable manufacturing solutions directly to consumers, all with a reducing carbon footprint.

At Hyperion, innovation is at the core of everything we do.
